content.short: SNS is the naming service for Solana, letting you register a .sol domain and use it instead of a long wallet address.
content.description: With SNS, a wallet address can become a name like alice.sol that works across hundreds of integrated apps and wallets. Domains are NFTs, so they can be traded on secondary markets. Owners can attach a profile and avatar, create unlimited subdomains, and host a simple website on IPFS through sol.site. Developers can add .sol lookups through the SNS SDK. It now offers .sns domains that AI agents can manage, turns a domain into a live web2 site through sol.site, and gives Seeker phone owners a free domain.
content.meta: Register .sol domains on Solana to replace wallet addresses, host sites and build an identity. Explore Solana Name Service on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
